Click a contact to view the full detail with timeline
Bulk actions let you change stage or add tags to multiple contacts

pipeline.title: How does the Pipeline work?
pipeline.description: The sales funnel visualizes which stage each opportunity is in. Drag cards between columns to move deals. Stages are configurable from Settings.
tips: Drag a card to a terminal stage to request approval
Cards with a yellow badge are pending approval
Customize stages in Settings → Tools → Pipeline stages

appointments.title: How to manage appointments?
appointments.description: Schedule appointments, configure services with duration and price, manage your team's availability, and connect external calendars (Google/Microsoft).
tips: Configure your services with price and duration so the AI agent can schedule automatically
Connect Google Calendar for two-way appointment sync
Reminders are sent automatically 24h and 1h before

properties.title: How to manage properties?
properties.description: Manage your vacation rental apartments. Add photos, amenities, prices and rules. Sync availability with Airbnb and Booking.com using iCal.
tips: The calendar is the main view — shows availability in green, bookings in red and external blocks in orange
Paste the iCal URL from Airbnb/Booking to sync automatically every 30 minutes
Copy your export URL and paste it in Airbnb/Booking so they see your direct bookings

broadcast.title: How to send campaigns?
broadcast.description: Send mass messages to your contacts via WhatsApp using Meta-approved templates. Segment your audience by tags, stage or saved segments.
tips: You can only send Meta-approved templates (not free-form messages)
Schedule the send for a specific date and time
Monitor metrics: sent, delivered, read, failed

automation.title: How to create automations?
automation.description: Create rules that run automatically when an event occurs. For example: when a hot lead arrives, assign to a specific agent. Or when there is no response in 4 hours, send a follow-up.
tips: Each rule has: trigger (when), conditions (if), and actions (then)
Nurturing automations send follow-ups to leads that don't respond
You can activate/deactivate rules without deleting them

agent.title: How to configure the AI Agent?
agent.description: Your AI agent automatically responds to your customers' messages. Configure its name, personality, rules, forbidden topics, and assigned channels. Use pre-designed templates for your industry.
tips: Each channel (WhatsApp, Instagram, etc.) can have a different agent
The agent respects the rules and forbidden topics you configure
Test your agent in the Test section before activating it

knowledge.title: How does the Knowledge Base work?
knowledge.description: The knowledge base feeds the AI agent with information about your business. Upload documents, create FAQs, and define policies. The agent searches here before responding.
tips: FAQs are the fastest way to teach the agent
Documents are processed with AI (RAG) for contextual answers
The more information you load, the better the agent will respond

analyticsV2.title: How to read Analytics?
analyticsV2.description: Analytics show your business performance: conversations, AI resolution, campaigns, CSAT, and more. Use date filters for different periods.
tips: The 'AI & Bot' tab shows how many conversations AI resolved without human intervention
The 'CRM' tab links to funnel and pipeline velocity analytics
Export reports in CSV from the download button

channels.title: How to connect channels?
channels.description: Connect your messaging channels to receive and respond to messages from the platform. WhatsApp uses Embedded Signup, Instagram and Messenger use OAuth, Telegram uses Bot Token.
tips: WhatsApp requires a WhatsApp Business account
Instagram requires a professional account connected to a Facebook page
Each channel can have a different AI agent assigned

users.title: How to manage the team?
users.description: Manage your team users. Assign roles (admin, supervisor, agent), configure skills for smart routing, and reset passwords.
tips: Agents only see conversations assigned to them
Supervisors can view all conversations and reports
Skills are used to assign conversations to the most suitable agent

settings.title: What can I configure?
settings.description: Settings are organized in 5 sections: Account (your profile and security), Company (info and hours), Tools (attributes, macros, templates), AI (providers and config), and Advanced (alerts and integrations).
tips: In 'Company' configure your business hours — the agent respects them
In 'Tools' customize pipeline stages and lead scoring
In 'AI' configure which LLM model to use (GPT-4, Claude, Gemini, etc.)

tenants.title: Super Admin Panel
tenants.description: Manage all platform tenants. View health metrics, activity, AI configuration, and billing status for each company.
tips: The Health Score (0-100) indicates how well configured each tenant is
Use 'Impersonate' to view the platform as if you were the tenant
The 'Activity' tab shows messages, conversations and handoffs

financials.title: What do Financials show?
financials.description: Platform financial metrics: MRR, ARR, churn, LTV, and profitability per tenant. Only visible to super administrators.
tips: MRR is calculated from active subscriptions (not trials)
The 'Costs' tab shows infrastructure + LLM costs per tenant
Generate monthly snapshots for historical tracking
